title: Turn your RingCentral conversations into action with ChatGPT and Claude
summary: RingCentral brings calls, messages, voicemails, and SMS into LLMs like Claude and ChatGPT to unlock valuable conversation insights.
body_markdown:
### Key takeaways


- RingEX connects to chat-based LLMs like Claude and ChatGPT through connectors and plugins.
- Bring rich conversation data and interaction context into the LLMs business users work in daily. Take action on your calls, voicemails, and SMS without leaving your LLM.
- A RingCentral customer, Orangetheory Fitness owner, cut message review time from 45 minutes to under 5 minutes. One CTO cut his review time by 98%.
- Setup takes a few minutes.


## Bring RingCentral into the tools you already work in


RingEX already holds your calls, voicemails, and SMS. We understand our customers work with a variety of tools to do their work, which is why RingEX directly connects with hundreds of apps through integrations and APIs.


Now, with MCP connectors and plugins, we’re bringing that same secure, trusted, governed RingEX data into LLMs like Claude and ChatGPT, so you can unlock conversations and interaction context right inside your preferred LLM.


### Add RingCentral to your chat-based LLM in minutes


Install the plugin, sign in with your RingCentral account, and start gaining actionable insights from your calls, voicemails, texts, and team chat.


[Learn more](https://ringcentral.com/apps/p/ai-tools)


That means you can take action on what’s already in RingEX, without leaving your LLM. This is beneficial across a variety of departments in your business:


- A sales rep can ask who hasn’t responded to a follow-up by reviewing call notes and team messages with a quick summary.
- A manager can get a summary of what happened across ten conversations.
- A sales owner can combine call history and CRM data to prioritize leads and generate talking points for outreach.


## What is MCP, and how does it work with RingEX?


MCP stands for Model Context Protocol. It’s a common way for LLMs to connect to business software like RingEX, so an LLM like Claude can read your conversations and take action on it. Once connected, an LLM can pull your call records, read your message history, or send a text, all from the same chat window you’re already using.


MCP connectors do more than just move data into your LLM. It gives your LLM conversation memory and context, so it can connect what happened on a call last week to the message you’re drafting today.


RingCentral offers a[RingEX plugin for ChatGPT](https://ringcentral.com/apps/p/ai-tools) that covers voice and SMS, along with a[RingEX connector for Claude](https://ringcentral.com/apps/p/ai-tools) that brings your calls, voicemails, SMS, and messages into your conversations. Both are free for RingCentral users. Entitlement for customer access follows their license entitlement.


Each connection uses standard OAuth login, the same kind of secure sign-in you use for other business apps. Your organization’s call logs, messages, and voicemails stay inside RingCentral’s existing security setup, and it works within your company’s current admin policies.


## Getting started takes minutes


Connecting RingCentral plugins and MCPs to ChatGPT or Claude doesn’t require a developer or a long setup process. For ChatGPT, install the RingEX phone plugin from the ChatGPT marketplace, and sign in with your RingCentral account to approve access. For Claude, add the RingEX connector from Settings > Connectors, then sign in and approve access the same way.


For a full walkthrough, see our[setup guide](https://support.ringcentral.com/article-v2/setting-up-ringcentral-for-llms.html?brand=RingCentral&product=RingEX&language=en_US) .


## RingCentral communications in your LLM: Improving your day-to-day


A single customer relationship unfolds across dozens of touchpoints: a call last month, a text follow-up, a chat message, a voicemail left in between. Each one used to live in its own log, on its own screen, with nothing connecting them. Connecting RingCentral to your LLM turns scattered history into one continuous record, so your LLM isn’t piecing together fragments, it’s starting from the full picture.


That changes what asking a question actually gets you. Ask for one detail and skip digging through the whole thread. Get a summary and skip reading every message yourself. Then, send the reply, update the record, or take the next step, all from the same conversation.


## Why this is worth setting up


Take action on communication data the moment you need it. Connecting RingEX and RingCentral to your LLM turns your calls, texts, and chats into something you can ask about directly: who needs a follow-up, what happened on a call, or which messages need a reply today. It’s a short setup step, and it works with the LLM you’re probably already using.


*Learn more about RingCentral integrated apps at our*[app gallery](http://ringcentral.com/apps) .


## FAQs


**What is MCP, in plain terms?**
MCP is a protocol that lets an LLM, like Claude or ChatGPT, connect to your RingCentral communications data. It connects the two, so the LLM/AI assistant can read things like call records and messages, and take actions like sending a text.


**Which LLMs can connect to RingCentral?**
RingCentral MCPs are available for all LLMs. RingCentral plugins and connectors are available on the Claude and ChatGPT Marketplaces.


**Is the RingCentral plugin for ChatGPT and connector for Claude secure?**
Yes. Each connection uses standard OAuth login for authorization. Your organization’s call logs, voicemails, and messages stay inside RingCentral’s existing security setup, and it works within your company’s current admin policies.


**Does it cost anything to use RingCentral’s connectors and plugins?**
No. RingCentral’s ChatGPT plugins and Claude connector are free for existing RingCentral users. Note: prompting ChatGPT or Claude through these connections counts toward your own credit usage with those tools. Any SMS messages you send through the connection count toward your RingCentral plan’s usage.


**Do I need a developer to connect RingCentral’s ChatGPT plugins or Claude connector?**
No. Turning on a plugin or connector takes a few minutes. You connect it once, then start asking your LLM questions about your RingCentral communications data.


**Can RingCentral’s ChatGPT plugins and Claude connector help teams outside of sales and customer service?**
Yes. Any team that deals with a high volume of calls and messages can use it to cut down on manual review, including customer-facing staff, engineering teams, and product teams tracking updates.
